title: The Wright Flyer
lineage: Inspected the cited passage; retained file is a paraphrased research note, not the original source.

passages.locator: Aircraft description, first flight and specifications
passages.note: Orville flew the powered Flyer at Kitty Hawk on 17 December 1903 for 12 seconds and 120 feet; it had wing warping, rudder, elevator and a four-cylinder engine.
